description_en: A local women’s group recites the Nāmasaṅgīti verses on auspicious days and the holy month of Guṃlā here at the Phalcā constructed during the Śāha period.The three-bay Phalcā stands west of the Taḥ Bāhāḥ Dabū (LAL0066). As the Phalcā is constructed next to the Dabū, it is named Dabū Phalcā. People have started to call it Nāmasaṅgīti Phalcā, as the Nāmasaṅgīti verses are recited here. The Phalcā facing east has three bays. A Licchavicaityais established west of the Phalcā. The statues of Buddhas on the niche on all four sides of the Caitya appear to have been installed later.There is a badly-damaged inscription here that probably records the initial construction of the Phalcā. But as many letters of the inscription are unreadable, it is unclear when the Phalcā was constructed. The script and language of the inscription suggest that the Phalcā was constructed during the Śāha period. There is a mention of ‘deceased’ in the inscription, which suggests that Putalināni, Bhājudeva, Jayalachimi, Lādhāmuni, and Gyānavira constructed the Phalcā in memory of a deceased family member. The chariot festival of Buṅgadyaḥ could not take place in the usual manner in 2020 CE due to the Covid-19 pandemic. The statue of Buṅgadyaḥ was supposed to be accessioned to the chariot on April 24, 2020, but the chariot was not constructed due to the pandemic. Therefore, the statue was placed on the Phalcā until it was accessioned to the chariot on July 25, 2020.Previously, the Macchindra Bahāla Sudhāra Samiti, a committee formed for the conservation of the area, used to look after the Phalcā. The committee handed over the responsibility to a group of local women named Śrī Karuṇāmaya Misā Pucaḥ after the statue of Buṅgadyaḥ was taken from the Phalcā to be accessioned to the chariot in 2020 CE. The women’s group is using and taking care of the Phalcā since then. The group also installed a statue of Nāmasaṅgīti at the Phalcā in 2020 CE. The Misā Pucaḥ has since started the tradition of reciting the Nāmasaṅgīti verses here at the Phalcā on auspicious days like the full moon day, the first day of a solar month, etc. and also throughout the holy month of Guṃlā.
description_ne: शाहकालमा निर्माण गरिएको यो फल्चामा श्री करुणामय मिसा पुच:ले अष्टमी, पूर्णिमा, संक्रान्ति र गुंला महिनाभरि बिहान नामसंगीतिको पाठ गर्दै आइरहेको छ ।त: बाहा: परिसरमा रहेको त: बाहा: दबू (LAL0066) को पश्चिममा यो फल्चा रहेको छ । डबलीको सँगै रहेकोले यसलाई दबू फल्चा भनिएको हो । नामसंगीति स्थापना गरिएकोले यस फल्चालाई नामसंगीति फल्चा पनि भन्न थालिएको छ । पूर्वाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको यस फल्चामा तीनवटा कवल बनाइएका छन् । फल्चाको पश्चिममा एउटा चैत्य रहेको छ । लिच्छविकालीन यस चैत्यका चारै दिशाका गवाक्षहरूमा राखिएका चार बुद्ध मूर्तिहरू चाहिँ पछि मात्र थपिएका देखिन्छन् ।यो फल्चाभित्र एउटा शिलापत्र राखिएको छ जुन फल्चाको निर्माणसँग सम्बन्धित हुनसक्छ । तर शिलापत्रको धेरैजसो भागका अक्षरहरू पढ्न नसकिने अवस्थामा छन् । त्यसैले फल्चाको निर्माण कहिले गरिएको थियो भन्ने मिति थाहा पाइँदैन । शिलापत्रको लिपि र भाषाको अध्ययनबाट यो फल्चा शाहकालमा निर्माण गरिएको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । शिलापत्रमा पुतलिनानि, भाजुदेव, जयलछिमि, लाधामुनि, ग्यानविरको नाम कुँदिएको देखिन्छ । शिलापत्रमा दिवंगत भन्ने शब्द पनि परेकोले मृत्यु भएको कुनै व्यक्तिको नाममा उसको परिवारले फल्चा निर्माण गरेको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । विसं २०७६-२०७७ (सन् २०२०) को बुंगद्य:को रथजात्रा कोविड-१९ को कारणले प्रभावित भएको थियो । विसं २०७७ वैशाख १२ गते (सन् २०२० अप्रिल २४) शुक्रवार बुंगद्य:लाई रथमा राख्नुपर्ने भएतापनि कोविड-१९ को कारणले रथ निर्माण गरिएको थिएन । त्यसैले बुंगद्य:लाई त: बाहा:मा रहेको मन्दिरबाट निकालेर यसै फल्चामा राखिएको थियो । विसं २०७७ श्रावण १० गते (सन् २०२० जुलाई २५) शनिवार रथारोहण नगराएसम्म बुंगद्य:लाई यसै फल्चामा राखिएको थियो ।पहिले मच्छिन्द्र बहाल सुधार समितिले यो फल्चाको रेखदेख गर्दै आइरहेको थियो । विसं २०७७ (सन् २०२०) मा बुंगद्य:लाई यस फल्चाबाट लगेर पुल्चोकमा रथारोहण गराइसकेपछि मच्छिन्द्र बहाल सुधार समितिले श्री करुणामय मिसा पुच: नामक संस्थालाई यो फल्चाको जिम्मेवारी हस्तान्तरण गरेको थियो । त्यसै बेलादेखि श्री करुणामय मिसा पुच:ले फल्चाको भोगचलन गरिरहेको छ । महिलाहरूको यसै संस्थाले विसं २०७७ (सन् २०२०) मा फल्चामा नामसंगीतिको मूर्ति स्थापना गरेको थियो । त्यसै समयदेखि अष्टमी, पूर्णिमा, संक्रान्तिमा र नेपाल संवत्‌को गुंला महिनाभरि बिहान नामसंगीतिको पाठ गर्दै आइरहेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Most of the letters on the inscription installed at the Phalcā are unreadable. Therefore, it is unclear when the Phalcā was first constructed. The script and language of the inscription suggest that the Phalcā was constructed during the Śāha period. The term ‘divaṃgata’, which means ‘the late’, is legible in the inscription. Probably, Putalināni, Bhājudeva, Jayalachimi, Lādhāmuni, and Gyānavira–the names featured in the inscription–constructed the Phalcā in memory of a deceased member of their family.

The Covid-19 pandemic disrupted the chariot festival of Buṅgadyaḥ in 2020 CE. The statue of Buṅgadyaḥ was supposed to be accessioned to the chariot on the 1stof the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha but the chariot was not constructed due to the pandemic. Therefore, the statue was placed here on Dabū Phalcā until it was accessioned to the chariot on July 25, 2020.
A signboard of Śrī Karuṇāmaya Misā Pucaḥ was installed on top of the central bay of the Phalcā.

historical_events.event_name: Installation of the statue of Nāmasaṅgīti
historical_events.event_description: Śrī Karuṇāmaya Misā Pucaḥ, a women’s group, installed a Nāmasaṅgīti statue made of an alloy of copper and zinc at the Phalcā.
